title: Appearance

hero.title: Design how your table looks and behaves
hero.lead: A live preview sits on the left and the settings panel on the right, so you see every change before you save it. Follow the tree below, or jump straight to a task.

tasks.text: Split a long table into pages

treeIntro: The branches match the three tabs of the settings panel, in the order most people work. Open any setting to see what it changes on your table.

branches.label: Colors
branches.goal: Set the color mood of the whole table in one click, or take full control.

nodes.label: Preset color schemes
nodes.changes: Recolors the search bar, header, rows, hover state and footer together with one of 14 ready-made schemes. The **Default** scheme adds no colors, so the table follows your theme.
nodes.visitors: The whole table in one consistent palette, with no per-color work from you.

nodes.label: Custom colors
nodes.changes: Lets you set the background, text and border of the search bar, header, body rows and footer one by one. You can also color odd and even rows differently.
nodes.visitors: Exactly your brand colors, including a different color for rows under the pointer.

branches.label: Style
branches.goal: Decide what sits above the table, which font it uses and how rows and borders look.

nodes.label: Title & Header
nodes.changes: Switches the table title, the description and the header row on or off above and inside the table.
nodes.visitors: A clean table with only the heading text you want shown.

nodes.label: Typography
nodes.changes: Changes the font family and the font size of the table text. The default, **Inherit From Theme**, copies your site font.
nodes.visitors: Text that matches your site, or stands out from it on purpose.

nodes.label: Rows & Borders
nodes.changes: Turns row stripes, hover highlight, borders and row spacing on or off. The options depend on the table engine and style library.
nodes.visitors: Rows that are easier to scan: zebra stripes, a highlighted row under the pointer, tighter or roomier cells.

branches.label: Features
branches.goal: Decide what visitors can do with the table, and how it behaves on every screen.

nodes.label: Search
nodes.changes: Adds a search box above the table. Visitors type a word and only matching rows stay visible. You control its wording, and on Pro its position and colors.
nodes.visitors: A search box that filters rows as they type, and your own message when nothing matches.

nodes.label: Sorting
nodes.changes: Lets visitors click a column heading to sort by it. **Default Order** sets the order rows appear in before anyone clicks.
nodes.visitors: Clickable headings, and a table that opens already ordered the way you chose.

nodes.label: Pagination
nodes.changes: Splits a long table into pages instead of one long scroll. You set the rows per page and where the page numbers sit.
nodes.visitors: Page numbers under the table, with a limited number of rows at a time.

nodes.label: Sticky Header & Column
nodes.changes: Pins the header row while visitors scroll down, and pins the first column while they scroll sideways.
nodes.visitors: Headings and row labels that never scroll out of view.

nodes.label: Responsive & Stackable Table
nodes.changes: Decides what a wide table does on a small screen. Columns can fold into a **+** drawer, rows can turn into cards, and a click can open the details of a row in a popup.
nodes.visitors: On phones, a table that fits the screen instead of forcing sideways scrolling.

nodes.label: Export & Print
nodes.changes: Adds **CSV**, **Excel** and **Print** buttons to the table on your site. You choose which buttons, their labels and colors, and where they sit.
nodes.visitors: Buttons that download or print the rows they are currently viewing, so a search they ran is kept.

branches.label: Beyond one table
branches.where: Gear icon › Settings, and the table's Custom CSS/JS tab
branches.goal: Reuse your design on every new table, or style what the panel does not cover.

nodes.label: Default design for new tables
nodes.changes: Sets the starting color, library, font, title, search, sorting and pagination of tables you create from now on. Tables you already have are never changed.
nodes.visitors: New tables that already look on-brand the moment they are created.

nodes.label: Custom CSS
nodes.changes: Adds your own styles for anything the panel does not cover.
nodes.visitors: A table styled beyond the built-in options.
